data.name: Braised Short Rib
data.description: Short ribs braised four hours in red wine, over sweet potato purée and spinach with pan gravy.

steps.title: Season and sear
steps.detail: Salt the ribs the day before. Sear hard on every side until deep brown.

steps.title: Braise for 4 hours
steps.detail: Cover with the braising liquid, lid on, in a 300°F oven until fork-tender.

steps.title: Rest and portion
steps.detail: Cool in the liquid overnight. Portion cold so each piece holds its shape.

steps.title: Make the pan gravy
steps.detail: Skim the fat, then reduce the braising liquid until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Fire to order
steps.detail: Reheat a portion in its gravy. Wilt the spinach in the same pan.

steps.title: Plate and pass
steps.detail: Spinach first, rib on top, gravy over, carrot ribbon last. Wipe the rim.

plating.name: Short rib
plating.note: on the spinach, best side up

plating.name: Pan gravy
plating.note: over the rib, pooling at the base

data.videoNote: A short walkthrough with the chef: the sear, the braise, the gravy and the plate. Watch it before your first shift on sauté, and again before you sign off.
data.inspiration: A classic French red wine braise
data.sellingLine: Fall-apart tender after a four-hour braise; deep, rich and comforting on a cold night.
